Show a chart in the web browser

Source: R/dashtools.R
plotHtml.Rd

Shows an htmlwidget (or rCharts) chart in the default web browser instead of the viewer pane of the IDE. Useful for charts which need a full browser window. Note: it sets options(viewer = ...) for the rest of the session, so later charts also open in the browser.

Usage

plotHtml(obj)

Arguments

obj

A chart, for example returned by rvisPlot().

Value

Called for its side effect (the chart is shown).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plotHtml(rvisPlot("bar", "echarts", obj = data.frame(a = c("x", "y"), b = 1:2), x = "a", y = "b"))
} # }
